title: Training Note: Card Chargeback Cushion on the Reporting-Floor Pay-Down, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Training note for collectors on **Placed Consumer Accounts**: the card chargeback cushion that applies to the reporting-floor pay-down when a credit-card payment is received on the handling date.

## The rule

The card chargeback cushion is:
- **$75.00** where a credit-card payment was received on the handling date and a card payment on the account was ever returned as a card chargeback;
- **$25.00** where a credit-card payment was received on the handling date and no card payment on the account was ever charged back;
- **nothing** where no credit-card payment was received on the handling date.

The cushion is added, at its full amount, in working out the reporting-floor pay-down.

## Questions and answers

**What is a credit-card payment received on the handling date?** A consumer payment on the account's money history through the credit-card channel, dated the handling date itself. A payment dated the day before does not count.

**What is a card chargeback?** A returned-payment entry on the account whose return reason is card chargeback. Any such entry at any date in the account's history counts. Returns for NSF, account closed, stop payment or unauthorized debit are not chargebacks.

**Does a chargeback in the past matter if no credit-card payment arrives on the handling date?** No. Without a credit-card payment dated the handling date the cushion is nothing.

## Condition table

| Credit-card payment dated the handling date | Card chargeback ever on the account | Cushion |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | $75.00 |
| Yes | No | $25.00 |
| No | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented histories.*

- A credit-card payment of $180.00 is dated the handling date; a debit-card payment was charged back two years earlier. Cushion $75.00.
- A credit-card payment of $180.00 is dated the handling date; the account's only return was an NSF bank debit. Cushion $25.00.
- The last credit-card payment was the day before the handling date. Cushion nothing.
